title: The Pharmacy
setting: 7pm. Apollo Pharmacy, Indiranagar 100ft Road. You've been ignoring a scratchy throat for three days and it's now a small fire. The pharmacist looks up from a packet of tablets he's labelling.

beats.prompt: You point at your throat. You say:

choices.native: ಗಂಟಲು ನೋವು ಸಾರ್. ಮೂರು ದಿನ ಆಯ್ತು. ಸಣ್ಣ fever ಕೂಡ ಇದೆ.
choices.translit: gaṇṭalu nōvu sār. mūru dina āytu. saṇṇa fever kūḍa ide.
choices.en: Throat pain, sir. Three days now. Small fever too.
My throat hurts. Bad. Three days.

beats.native: ಕೆಮ್ಮು ಬರ್ತಾ ಇದೆಯಾ? ಒಣಗಿದ ಕೆಮ್ಮು ಅಥವಾ ಕಫ?
beats.translit: kemmu bartā ideyā? oṇagida kemmu athavā kapha?
beats.en: Are you coughing? Dry cough or with phlegm?
beats.beat: puts the marker down. clinical now.

choices.en: Dry cough, sir. Worse at night.
Dry. Worse when I lie down.

beats.native: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ viral. ಎರಡು tablets ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ — fever ಮತ್ತು cough. ಮೂರು ದಿನ ತಗೋಳಿ. Spicy ಬೇಡ. ಬೆಚ್ಚಗಿನ ನೀರು ಜಾಸ್ತಿ.
beats.translit: sāmānya viral. eraḍu tablets koḍtīni — fever mattu cough. mūru dina tagoḷi. spicy bēḍa. beccagina nīru jāsti.
beats.en: Regular viral. I'll give you two tablets — fever and cough. Take for three days. No spicy. Lots of warm water.
beats.beat: already reaching for the right shelf

choices.native: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು ಸಾರ್. ಮೂರು ದಿನದ ನಂತರ ಸರಿ ಆಗದಿದ್ದರೆ?
choices.translit: dhanyavādagaḷu sār. mūru dinada nantara sari āgadiddare?
choices.en: Thanks sir. What if it's not better after three days?

beats.native: ಸರಿ ಆಗದಿದ್ದರೆ doctor ಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂದೆ ಒಂದು clinic ಇದೆ — Dr. Hegde, ಸಂಜೆ ಆರು ಗಂಟೆಯಿಂದ. ಎರಡು ತಿಂಗಳ ಮುಂಚೆ ನಾನೂ ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೇ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದೆ.
beats.translit: sari āgadiddare doctor-ge hōgi. illi munde ondu clinic ide — Dr. Hegde, sañje āru gaṇṭeyinda. eraḍu tiṅgaḷa mumce nānū allige hōgidde.
beats.en: If not better, go to a doctor. There's a clinic up ahead — Dr. Hegde, from 6pm. I went there myself two months ago.
beats.beat: the personal recommendation. you didn't pay for it but it's free.
